title: Hyundai Motor America: Air Bags & Seat Belt Pretensioners May Not Deploy in a Crash (37,901 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Veloster N, 2019-2023 Kona Electric vehicles. A software error in the air bag control unit (ACU) may improperly deactivate the air bag system and seat belt pretensioners.

title: Spencer Manufacturing, Inc.: Touch Screen Display May Fail (5 affected)
summary: Spencer Manufacturing, Inc. (Spencer) is recalling certain 2026 Rescue, 2025 Initial Attack, and 2024-2025 Pumper emergency vehicles. title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: Neutral Gear Displays When Transmission is Actually in Gear (21,643 affected)
summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2026 FLHXLSE, FLTRXSTSE, FLHXSTSE, FLHXSE, FLHXL, FLTRXP, FLTRX, FLTRXL, and FLHX motorcycles. The engine control module (ECM) may communicate the incorrect gear position of neutral when the transmission is actually in gear.
